answers.rationale: A-101 has an award amount of 50,000 (awards.csv) and recorded disbursements of 20,000 and 15,000 (disbursements.csv), totaling 35,000. Per program_rules.txt, remaining obligation equals award amount minus disbursements: 50,000 − 35,000 = 15,000.
A-102 is a SEED-FAST award (awards.csv). program_rules.txt states that SEED-FAST awards have no cash-match requirement.
awards.csv lists status_code A for A-101 and A-102 only. status_fragment.txt confirms A means Active. No other awards carry code A.

A-101 is a SEED-CORE award of 50,000 (awards.csv). program_rules.txt requires a cash match of 20% of the award amount for SEED-CORE awards unless a written waiver is on file. No waiver for A-101 appears in this packet, so the required match is 20% × 50,000 = 10,000.

A-104 has status_code S (awards.csv), but status_fragment.txt only defines A (Active) and C (Closed) and explicitly states that other codes are not listed. The meaning of S cannot be established from this packet.
